question:
In the events with more than forty incomes, list the city and country in which the event is happening.
Benchmark knowledge evidence: more than fifty incomes refers to income > 40

prediction.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT z.XCL_045 AS city, z.XCL_047 AS country
FROM event e
JOIN budget b ON b.XCL_009 = e.XCL_010
JOIN income i ON i.XCL_029 = b.XCL_003
JOIN member m ON m.XCL_034 = i.XCL_029
JOIN zip_code z ON z.XCL_043 = m.XCL_041
WHERE i.XCL_026 > 40
